context: Designed after known failures; existing 588/600 results already viewed; all new evaluation is retrospective.

road.source: EPA 2026 Test Car List, Target A/B/C only
road.duplicate_policy: Median each target coefficient within configuration; each configuration equal weight, not each drive-cycle test.
road.require: Finite A/B/C/weight; A>0, C>0, positive total force at 20/50/80/100/120 km/h
road.proxy: Median A/(test_weight_kg*g); reference constant-road-load equivalent, NOT a measured pure tire Cr.
road.experiment: Fix Cr at this proxy and refit other five stage8 parameters on training only. Compare objective, not claim a same-car rolling-resistance measurement.
road.provenance: Electricity-mode rows may include PHEV; cohort is not certified BEV-only. Equivalent test weight is not curb mass. Target A includes non-tire contributions.

temperature.data: Oxford ExampleDC_C1, original measured I/V/T; 740mAh different cell, chamber40C
temperature.evaluation: Last40% of same discharge, continuous forward temperature, no reset or measured-T correction
temperature.model: dT/dt=a*I^2-b*(T-40), a=R_heat/C, b=H/C positive; measured I is external-cell excitation, no vehicle-model fitting
temperature.claim: One-cell one-cycle temporal extrapolation only; no independent-cell validation, no target-pack/cabin precision guarantee, no separate R/C/H identification

sensor.decision: Use guarded direct sensor feedback; observer is exploratory only. Comfort22-26C and terminal energy accounting; no claim true24+-0.1C.
sensor.rules: Existing baseline and optimized rules, common guard and common pre-arrival cooling, same injected biases for paired strategies
sensor.certification: Uncertainty values are scenario assumptions, not calibrated error bounds. Sampled cases are not exhaustive robust certification.
sensor.terminal_accounting: Upper diagnostic adds Cc*(abs(Topt-Tbase)+2*1.05)/min(COP,heater_efficiency) and positive battery excess heat including2*1C in warm/hot cases. Idealized electricity estimate, not a guaranteed hardware bound.

voltage.model: One-RC Thevenin plus stage8 positive OCV scaling; full forward vehicle current/SOC/voltage; exact constant-current RC average and heat/storage balance each substep
voltage.training_selection: Smallest unchanged calibration composite objective among declared starts; freeze before new 588/600 evaluation. No retuning after evaluation.
voltage.adoption_gate: Retrospective voltage RMSE >=10% lower than stage8 on each evaluated trip; energy APE <= original+0.5pp and SOC RMSE <= original+0.2pp on each trip; no physical failures and energy/step checks pass. Otherwise keep old whole-vehicle model, permit labeling a limited diagnostic winner.
voltage.limits: Zero initial polarization is an assumption, no long rest confirmed. Bounds are engineering search ranges, not CIs. Does not solve low-SOC extrapolation.
